entry_contract: Continue from 19 Darkshore & Ashenvale, or select this chapter on a partially completed character. Begin in Stonetalon Mountains with Gaxim Rustfizzle. Leave at least two quest-log slots open.

steps.instruction: Travel from Ashenvale to Stonetalon Mountains. Use a known flight path when it saves time; otherwise follow roads and zone connections. Continue to [G59.52,67.15 Stonetalon Mountains]. [O]
Before you begin: travel to Stonetalon Mountains and meet the first quest giver at [G59.52,67.15 Stonetalon Mountains]. Leave at least two quest-log slots open. [O]
